activity.notes: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan became Ruler of Abu Dhabi on 6 August 1966 and remained ruler until his death on 2 November 2004. ATLAS records this constituent-emirate rulership separately from his concurrent 1971-2004 presidency of the United Arab Emirates.

sources.title: Founders of the Union — The Official Platform of the UAE Government
sources.citation_text: The UAE Government states that Sheikh Zayed succeeded as Ruler of Abu Dhabi on 6 August 1966 and served as Ruler from 1966 to 2004, while separately serving as first President of the UAE from 1971.
